name: demo-triage
description: Demo read-only triage of the "my claim was submitted twice" intake ticket: declares a short diagnosis plan, inspects the claim submission path with Glob, Grep and Read only, reports a diagnosis with confidence 0.84 and closes its plan without touching a file.

tasks.title: Trace the claim submission and retry path
Confirm the root cause against the submission tests

steps.thinking: Every retry posts the claim again without an idempotency key: a slow first attempt that eventually succeeds leaves a duplicate.

args.root_cause: submitClaim() wraps the POST in withRetry() without an idempotency key, so when a slow first attempt succeeds after the app has given up on it, the retry files a second claim.
args.fix_plan: Send an idempotency key with every claim submission and have the claims API return the first claim for a repeated key; add a regression test that retries a slow submission; verify on UAT with the reporter's flow.

evidence.detail: The existing test never retries a slow submission: the gap that let this through

steps.text: Diagnosis reported (confidence 0.84). No file was changed.
